#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int countEvenRuns(const std::string& s, int i, int runLen, int toPrint) {
    if (i >= (int)s.length()) {
        return toPrint;
    }
    if (i + 1 < (int)s.length() && s[i] == s[i + 1]) {
        return countEvenRuns(s, i + 1, runLen + 1, toPrint);
    } else {
        if (runLen % 2 == 0) {
            toPrint++;
        }
        return countEvenRuns(s, i + 1, 1, toPrint);
    }
}

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> str;
    int result = countEvenRuns(str, 0, 1, 0);
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
